title: Predictive coefficients for arbitrarily many noisy ancestors
checked_scope: Stationary Gaussian first-order status model with independent proxy noise; finite and stationary multigeneration prediction
significance: Derives the full Kalman-recursion coefficients showing every noisy ancestor can predict the next generation despite a latent first-order null, and recovers the manuscript's grandparent formula as a special case.
